messages:
Maya (Docs): Heads up — were targeting the v0.9.3 release cutoff tonight at 22:00 PT. Can we lock merges for docs PRs that modify /versions/0.9.3? I'll call out exceptions.
Alex (SRE): +1 on lock. Is that 22:00 orgwide or just docs?
Maya (Docs): Just docs for this window; engineering still has a separate freeze. Want to avoid last-minute versioned doc drift.
Sam (Product): Which PRs are high-priority to land before cutoff? I have the migration guide and SDK snippet fixes.
Emma (Docs): Migration guide PR (#4123) is ready but waiting for a second reviewer. I assigned @Alex earlier but he said he'd be on-call tonight.
Alex (SRE): I can take a look at the snippets, but note CI preview queue is slow — link-check failed on one external URL earlier.
ci-bot: Preview for PR #4123 available: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/4123 (status: failed - link-check).
Emma (Docs): Thanks @ci-bot. The link is an internal partner doc that should be removed; I just pushed a patch to the branch with the fix.
Maya (Docs): OK — plan: freeze merges to /versions/0.9.3 at 22:00 PT. Exceptions: hotfixes approved by a lead + one reviewer and with green CI preview. Please ping me in this thread for exceptions.
Sam (Product): For the SDK snippet changes, can we do a soft-merge window earlier? They don't change versioned content, only examples under /guides.
Maya (Docs): Yep — non-versioned guides can merge until 21:30 PT if they have at least one docs reviewer and green preview. After 21:30 treat as post-cutoff and coordinate with release lead.
Alex (SRE): I'll prioritize reviewing #4123 and #4130. If CI link-check fails again, I'll approve the docs-only PR with the caveat and file a follow-up ticket for link replacement — unless it blocks rendering.
Emma (Docs): Re: reviewers, please prefer docs-1 on these small PRs. For things touching code samples please cc @Sam.
Sam (Product): Noted. Also FYI: feature flag "new-embed-flow" will gate some examples. If PRs change gated content, mark with [feature-flag:new-embed-flow].
Maya (Docs): Good call. Add that tag to PR titles so release automation can skip them if the flag isn't enabled.
ci-bot: PR #4123 preview updated: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/4123 (status: success) :thumbsup:
Alex (SRE): I reviewed and left a tiny nit on spacing. Resolving now.
Emma (Docs): Merged #4123 at 20:55 PT — had green preview and one approver.
Maya (Docs): Thanks team. I'll post a final checklist at 21:45 PT listing any blocked docs PRs needing exception approvals before the 22:00 cutoff.
Sam (Product): I'll be on the lookout for that list.
Maya (Docs): If anyone needs an emergency merge after cutoff, ping me + @Alex with: PR link, reason, and CI preview link.
Alex (SRE): Roger.
